title: Measure ND from control structures only

intentCoverage.report:
**Verdict: Caught.**

**Story and revision:** SEED-078#nd-without-logical-operators ("Measure ND from control structures only"), plan .planning/slice-plans/048-nd-without-logical-operators/PLAN.md, revision 0e835a3a9ca9d816bf49f3033ce021795dad60bf (terryyin/lizard).

**Promise:** `&&`/`||` never open an ND level, inside or outside a condition, in the default C-family set and in Groovy's own set. Control structures keep their ND.

**Fault chosen:** I validated the suggestion and kept its Groovy variant. In lizard_languages/groovy.py, `GroovyReader.loops`, I added `'&&'`, so the set became `frozenset(('if','for','while','catch','case','try','?','?:','&&'))`. I picked Groovy over the default `loops` set in lizard_ext/lizardnd.py for one reason. The default C-family set is pinned by many tests in the rewritten file. Groovy's own set has exactly one maintained test, test_groovy_logical_operator_adds_no_depth, and that test was rewritten and moved into the new file. So it is the thinnest and riskiest proof of the promise.

**Maintained checks examined:** test/testNestingDepthLogicalOperators.py (10 tests) and test/testNestingDepth.py, run with one focused command: `python -m pytest -q test/testNestingDepthLogicalOperators.py test/testNestingDepth.py`.

**Run observations:**
- **Scratch setup:** a detached worktree at the checked revision, outside the execution worktree. I ran the execution checkout's flake from the scratch directory. Python imported lizard_ext/lizardnd.py and lizard_languages/groovy.py from the scratch path, which I confirmed by printing `__file__`.
- **Pre-probe state:** no tracked changes. The only ignored files were `.venv` and caches, created by the flake's shellHook.
- **Baseline:** 27 passed in 0.11s.
- **Under the fault:** 1 failed, 26 passed in 0.24s.
  - The failing test was `TestLogicalOperatorNestingDepth::test_groovy_logical_operator_adds_no_depth`, at test/testNestingDepthLogicalOperators.py:101. Its `assertEqual([('plain', 2), ('logical', 2)], ...)` got `[('plain', 2), ('logical', 3)]`.
- **Independent witness:** a separate scratch script ran the same Groovy source through FileAnalyzer with the ND extension. It returned `[('plain', 2), ('logical', 3)]`, which confirms the wrong behavior on the intended path: `&&` in an `if` condition inside a `for` adds a level.
- **Restoration:** I copied the original file back. `git status --short` and `git diff --stat` were empty, and HEAD was still 0e835a3a. The rerun passed 27 of 27 in 0.17s.
- **Cleanup:** I removed the scratch worktree with `git worktree remove --force`, which was needed because of the ignored `.venv`. The execution worktree's status stayed clean throughout. I never edited it and did not use stash.

**Claim bound:** This shows only that the Groovy `&&`-inside-a-condition path is caught by that one assertion. I did not probe `||` in Groovy, `&&`/`||` outside a condition in Groovy, or the default C-family set.

**Next proof action:** None needed for this path. If more confidence is wanted, the next single probe is Groovy `'||'`, or `&&` outside a condition in Groovy. The maintained Groovy test only uses `&&` inside an `if` condition, so those paths may have no Groovy-specific proof. That is unverified: no fault was observed there.

**Prior dispositions:** No already-planned repair or earlier disposition relates to this evidence. The probe gives no reason for a new repair.

**Costs:**
- **Test runtime (measured, from pytest's reported wall time):** 0.11s baseline, 0.24s faulted, 0.17s restored, about 0.52s in total. This excludes nix develop startup and the one-time venv dependency install in the scratch checkout.
- **Human effort:** unavailable. There was no human involvement to measure.
- **Agent effort:** unavailable. I had no separately supported measure, such as tokens or active time, from this session.

- **Invocation-to-report elapsed.** 68840 ms (measured), from 1795743772828 to 1795743841668 in Unix epoch ms. The end clock was sampled after writing the prepared report body.

---

Wrap-up disposition: checked revision 0e835a3a, verdict Caught, no follow-up.
